newsitem.title: INDONESIA: At least 41 die on roads during Indonesian holiday.
newsitem.headline: At least 41 die on roads during Indonesian holiday.

text.p: At least 41 people died and 55 were injured in traffic accidents in Indonesia during the two-day Eid al-Fitr Moslem celebrations, the official Antara news agency reported on Tuesday.

Antara said most of the victims came from Sunday's accident in West Java when an intercity bus plunged into a gorge near the village of Cijapati, about 60 km (40 miles) southeast of the provincial capital of Bandung.
Twenty people were killed and 28 injured after the bus crashed while trying to negotiate a steep curve.
The agency said the second big accident occurred on Monday in Cirebon, also in West Java, when an inter-city bus crashed into a van, killing 11 people and injuring 14 others.

Cirebon police chief Lieutenant-Colonel Ade Rahardja said the roads in the region were prone to accidents because many drivers coming from the capital Jakarta were already tired by the the time they reached the town, about four hours away.
Antara said the other accidents took place in Bogor and Ciamis. It gave no other details.

Millions of Indonesians travelled the country's roads on the weekend as they returned to their home towns and villages to celebrate the Eid al-Fitr holiday on Sunday and Monday which marks the end of the Ramadan fasting month.
